The prior adapter discarded HTTP status when normalizing provider errors. The old live failure cannot be retroactively diagnosed from available usage metadata.
Concern and family-document change declarations emitted exclusiveMinimum for positive integers. Equivalent minimum:1 declarations remove that unsupported field while preserving validation.

The same optional tool declarations still contain oneOf; concern archive/restore also has enum:[true]. Those shapes are not listed by the official Vertex v1 Schema contract. They remain unchanged as a separately identified compatibility risk; they are not proven to have caused the ordinary-note failure.
